pluginMetaData.name: ASTM E1381 Transmission Mode (bitdreamit)
pluginMetaData.author: Bit Dream IT
pluginMetaData.description: ASTM E1381-02 lower-layer transmission framing protocol. Implements ENQ/ACK/NAK establishment, STX/ETB/ETX framing with Add-Mod-256 checksum, 0-7 frame sequencing with strict/lenient modes, per-frame retry with exponential backoff, per-phase timeouts (establishment, frame, response), and a per-session RetryMetrics counter for operational dashboards. Transport-agnostic: works with TCP Listener / TCP Sender and Serial Connector.
